table_data.paper_title: Evolution of Pulsars in the P–$dot{P}$ Plane and the Role of Inclination Angle Decay

columns.Magnetic Inclination Dynamics: Alignment of magnetic and rotation axes over time
columns.Torque and Braking Index Modeling: Variable braking torque including $\dot{\alpha}$ term; eliminates need for field decay or long birth periods
columns.Emission Geometry Evolution: Not explicitly detailed; focuses on population distribution in P-$\dot{P}$ plane

table_data.paper_title: Rotational Evolution and Pulsar Death Valley Trajectory Driven by Wind and Dipole Radiation

columns.Primary Evolutionary Mechanism: Transition from magnetic dipole radiation to particle wind dominance
columns.Magnetic Inclination Dynamics: Calculated evolution; lower braking index due to high particle density
columns.Torque and Braking Index Modeling: Combined wind and dipole model; explains sub-dipole braking indices via glitch-induced magnetospheric activity
columns.Emission Geometry Evolution: Trajectory towards pulsar death valley rather than magnetar cluster

table_data.paper_title: Progressive Narrowing of Pulsar Emission Cones and Axis Alignment

columns.Primary Evolutionary Mechanism: Axis alignment combined with emission cone narrowing
columns.Magnetic Inclination Dynamics: Progressive alignment over ~1 Myr timescale; random initial birth angles fit best
columns.Torque and Braking Index Modeling: Braking index parameter $n_\gamma \approx 2.3$ consistent with mean observed values
columns.Emission Geometry Evolution: Progressive narrowing of emission cones; predicts beaming fraction vs. characteristic age

table_data.paper_title: Modeling Braking Index and Jerk Parameter Deviations via Torque Function Growth

columns.Torque and Braking Index Modeling: Constant observed braking index $n_{obs}$ but growing torque function; accounts for jerk parameter deviations ($m_{obs} \neq 15$)

table_data.paper_title: High-Precision Pulsar Timing Solutions and Mitigation of Timing Noise Effects

columns.Torque and Braking Index Modeling: Demonstrates that non-whitened residuals yield spurious braking indices dominated by timing noise
columns.Timing Noise Mitigation Strategy: Whitening of timing residuals before fitting; multi-harmonic profile weighting implied for accuracy

table_data.paper_title: Seven-Year Timing Analysis of Accretion-Powered Millisecond Pulsar SAX J1808.4-3658

columns.Primary Evolutionary Mechanism: Spin-down during quiescence; propeller effect/mass loss
columns.Torque and Braking Index Modeling: Upper limits on short-term spin changes; long-term spin-down attributed to quiescent torques
columns.Timing Noise Mitigation Strategy: Multi-harmonic Fourier decomposition with variance-based weighting to account for red noise/pulse shape variability
columns.Emission Geometry Evolution: Systematic pulse profile changes correlated with luminosity; hot spot longitudinal drift
